publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Sabino

record.title: Fewer atomic traps do not yet establish a faster UI
record.method: One paired OFF/ON physical interaction replay with original userspace
record.observation: The paired replay reduced mean legacy atomic trap rates by 98.50–99.91% across four interaction windows. Mean frame gaps improved in two windows and worsened in two, so a consistent UI speedup was not established.
record.limits: One pair is not a randomized performance study. Frame gaps include intentional pauses and are not app-open latency or animation FPS. Some UART gap rows were damaged; startup slowdown, contention and SMP behavior remain open.

records.access: Private project record; only the selected excerpt is distributed

exhibits.title: Fewer atomic traps do not yet establish a faster UI
exhibits.interpretation: Removing the measured instruction hotspot is a validated local improvement. A whole-application speed claim needs its own matched latency measurement.
